title: Kurinji
overview: Laly, a housewife from Kerala, has lived apart from her husband Mohan, a migrant labourer in the Gulf, for years. With only weekly phone calls & visits every two years, she has built a life around his absence. But when his phone calls and money transfers abruptly stop, Laly's life is thrown into turmoil. She finds herself unable to remember his face, and embarks on a search for answers to his disappearance.
